{{Quote|Trespassers on the vehicle! Fan out and eliminate!|Denwade Banevans, to the other range troopers|<ref name="SoloOG" />}}
'''Denwade Banevans''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[range trooper]] [[captain]] on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]]. He led the security forces tasked with the protection of the [[20-T Railcrawler conveyex transport|conveyex]] [[train]] lines on Vandor, and was one of the toughest [[officer]]s stationed on the world. In [[10 BBY]], he was traveling on the [[hovertrain]] [[ICC-5537]] when a [[Beckett's gang|group of criminals]] attempted to [[Heist on Vandor|steal]] the [[coaxium]] being carried on the vehicle. Banevans led his men in an attempt to prevent the theft, but was shot and [[Death|killed]] by the criminals' leader, [[Tobias Beckett]].

==Biography==
===Icy assignment===
{{Quote|Here they come!|Beckett spots Banevans and his men|audio=Beckett-HereTheyCome.flac|<ref name="Solo" />}}
Denwade Banevans was a [[human]]<ref name="SoloOG" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Bust" /> from the [[planet]] [[Carida]] who served in the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during its [[Imperial Era|reign]] across [[the galaxy]]. He was stationed as a [[range trooper]] with the rank of [[captain]] on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]],<ref name="SoloOG" /> where he was leader of the security forces for the Imperial [[20-T Railcrawler conveyex transport]] lines.<ref name="Bust" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> the captain traveled with a [[squad]] on board the [[hovertrain]]<ref name="Solo" /> designated [[ICC-5537]] in order to protect its cargo of [[coaxium]] [[fuel]] while it was transported to [[Crispin Imperial Depository]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

While ICC-5537 was headed toward the depository, a [[Beckett's gang|gang]] of criminals led by the outlaw [[Tobias Beckett]] boarded the train using a stolen [[Y-45 armored transport hauler]]. The [[Starship|hauler]] dropped Beckett and two of his accomplices, [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]], on top of the train, where they made their way along to the car containing the coaxium. Once they had confirmed its location, the hauler returned so they could attach it to the car;<ref name="Solo" /> however, Banevans and his men had realized something strange was going on and after detecting the threat<ref name="Bust" /> the captain ordered his men to fan out and eliminate the intruders.<ref name="SoloOG" />

===Battle on the train===
{{Listen3|Banevans-Death.flac|Denwade Banevans groans as he is killed}}
The Banevans and the other Imperials emerged onto the roof of the rearmost train car and opened fire on Beckett's gang,<ref name="Solo" /> using their [[Magnetomic gription boot|gription boot]] to stay securely on the train as it moved at 90 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> This prevented the criminals from making the attachments to the car carrying the coaxium, so Beckett returned fire while Solo and Chewbacca began climbing down the car they were on to detach it from the rearward cars. Banevans progressed furthest toward the criminals before being shot in the chest by Beckett and [[Death|killed]]. The captain's corpse was held in place on the train by his [[boot]]s while the rest of his squad kept progressing along the top and side of the train.<ref name="Solo" />

Solo and Chewbacca severed the connection between and the cars carrying Banevans' body and his troopers were disconnected from the front half of the train and slowly ground to a halt, leaving the surviving range troopers unable to confront the criminal gang. Both the front portion of ICC-5537 and the coaxium were ultimately destroyed after the rival [[Cloud-Riders]] group attacked Beckett's men in order to steal the coaxium for themselves.<ref name="Solo" />

==Personality and traits==
Denwade Banevans was one of the toughest [[officer]]s among all of the [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] stationed on Vandor. He had no intention of letting anyone steal Imperial property without a fight, ultimately costing him his life.<ref name="Bust" /> He stood 1.80 [[meter]]s (5 [[foot]], 11 inches) tall.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Equipment==
Banevans wore standard range trooper [[vambrace armor]] including magnetic gription boots and a [[synth-fur]] line [[kama]]. The captain carried a [[E-10R blaster rifle]] and [[water]]proof stowage packs for survival gear.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Denwade Banevans first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Solo" /> and was first named in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> Banevans' name was created as an homage to the [[1950s#1957|1957]] film [[Wikipedia:3:10 to Yuma|''3:10 to Yuma'']], being an [[Tuckerization|amalgamation]] of the names of two characters from the film, Ben Wade and Dan Evans.<ref name="Reference">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/1159624220638240768|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Yep. Had forgotten about that.|nobackup=1}} {{C|in response to "''Hey Pablo, Denwade Banevans' name is a reference to 3:10 to Yuma?''"}}</ref>
